notes: The 11 separate groups are real, so no joins were added. The booklet builds four separate models: the police airboat (b5-b29), the raft (b30-b40), the swamp scene (b44-b55) and the crocodile (b57-b60). Inside each model every piece is connected.

The other seven groups are single pieces that nothing in the parts list holds. Minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, hats, hair, beards, backpack) are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded. Pieces held only by minifigures are listed with no joins: b1 banknote, b2 hilt with b3 flashlight beam (b3 is joined to b2 only), b4 handcuffs, b41 and b42 oars, b43 shovel. The snake b56 is placed loose beside the swamp scene and clutches nothing.
The wedge plate b11 rests on the white slope b8 and the hull b5, not on the studless grooved tiles b9 and b10.
The banknote b50 rests on the baseplate b44. The drawings do not clearly show how it and the 2x2 tile b48 share the centre, so this is a best reading.

The raft is built as an upright wall: plate, log, two round bricks and a tan side-stud brick, log, two round bricks and a tan brick, log, plate. The model is then turned over, so the tan side studs face up as the deck.

Airboat rests_on lists are inferred from small drawings. The bracket b17 is taken to sit on the rear studs of the black plates and the 2x4 brick. The dish b27 is taken to sit on the bracket, with the 2x2 pin plate b28 on the dish. The propeller turns on that pin.
Binoculars and radio are assigned to the two horizontal clip plates by guess. The picture does not show which clip holds which.
The lime round plate b55 is taken to sit on the bamboo plant b51, and the bamboo plant on the front log b49. The leaves b53 sit on the bar of plate b52, and the spider b54 on b53.
